=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:3623 (`_fetch_issue_labels_batch_graphql`), 15768 (`_fetch_candidate_issue_details_graphql`) | severity=high | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Both batched GraphQL label fetchers hard-code `labels(first: 50) { nodes { name } }` and never check `pageInfo { hasNextPage }`. The fix introduces a `judge_engine_labels_valid` gate that marks the snapshot "verified" simply because it parses as a JSON array of strings, but does not verify completeness. A label snapshot truncated at 50 entries is treated the same as a fully-fetched one.
  WHY: When an AI pipeline issue accumulates more than 50 labels and `ai:codex` falls past position 50, the per-issue judge selector in `poller_judge_isolated` (line 247) sees no `ai:codex` and falls through to `ai:engine-claude` in `claude_engine.py:401-402`. For the managed judge path the truncated issue labels are then combined with `TRACKING_LABELS`, so an `ai:engine-claude` on the tracking issue selects Claude even though the judged issue carries `ai:codex`. The selector only logs `AI_ENGINE_SELECTED role=… engine=claude source=label:ai:engine-claude` and the issue content reaches the Claude sandbox — the exact disclosure the original fix is meant to prevent.

- Requirement: "Pass the judged issue's verified labels into engine selection; default to codex when that label snapshot is unavailable."
  Expected change site: scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh at the GraphQL label fetches (lines 3623 and 15768), or in `poller_judge_engine_labels_json` so it returns `unavailable` when `pageInfo.hasNextPage` is true
  Evidence of absence: Neither fetcher requests `labels { totalCount }` / `pageInfo { hasNextPage endCursor }`. `poller_judge_engine_labels_json` only inspects the array shape (jq `select(type == "array" and all(.[]; type == "string"))`), so a 50-element truncated snapshot is returned as a verified engine-selection input. No diff hunk in either the original PR or the last-run autofix adds pagination, totals, or a completeness probe.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===

  PROBLEM: A truncated label list is treated as a complete, verified snapshot.
  WHY: If an issue has more than 50 labels and `ai:codex` is outside the returned page, the engine-label validator still accepts the array. A managed stall or review-blocked judge then combines that incomplete list with tracking labels; when those select Claude, the judge runs on Claude despite the issue’s `ai:codex` label.

=== FINDINGS FROM qwen_qwen3_7-plus ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:3623 (labels query), 224-243 (poller_judge_engine_labels_json) | severity=high | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The label snapshot used for engine selection is capped at 50 labels per issue without pagination checks. If an issue has >50 labels and `ai:codex` falls outside the first 50, the managed judge will not see it and may select Claude instead.
  WHY: `_fetch_issue_labels_batch_graphql` queries `labels(first: 50)` without checking `pageInfo.hasNextPage`. The new `poller_judge_engine_labels_json` validates the input structure but not completeness. When the snapshot is incomplete but structurally valid, engine selection proceeds with missing labels. A managed issue with `ai:codex` at position 51+ would have its content sent to Claude despite the Codex label.
=== END FINDINGS FROM qwen_qwen3_7-plus ===
